senses.gloss: m. (contr. of נענע, v. letter ו; cmp. זִיז = זוזו) fish.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jonah 2:1">Targ. Jon. II, 1</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 11:17">Targ. Lev. XI, 17</cite>; <cite ref="Deuteronomy 14:17">Deut. XIV, 17</cite> <he>שלי נונא</he>, v. <he>שָׁלֵינוּנָא</he>.—
Ned. 54ᵇ נו״ן סמ״ך עי״ן נ׳ סמא לעינים the succession of the letters Nun, Samekh, ʿAyin serves as an intimation, ‘fish is a remedy for the eyes’.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11:4">Gen. R. s. 11</cite>; a. fr.—

Ab. Zar. 39ᵃ שפר נ׳ (καλλίχθος) sh’far nuna, name of a fish of the genus anthias; קדש נ׳ (ἱερὸς ἰχθύς) K’dash nuna, a name for anthias, called by some קבר נ׳ (Ar. קברנונא, in one w.) Ḳ’bar nuna (Grave-fish); [for corr. vers., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70, a. Tosaf. a. l.].

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 39a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>לשפרנונא</he> (Ms. M. in two words).—Pl. <he>נוּנִין</he>, <he>נוּנַיָּא</he>, <he>נוּנַיָּיה</he>, <he>נוּנֵי</he> <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 4:18">Targ. Deut. IV, 18</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Naz. IX, 57ᵈ, v. <cite ref="R00507"><he>צְלֵי</he> I</cite>.—Y. Ned. IV, beg. 39ᶜ, v. <cite ref="H00954"><he>חל</he></cite>; a. fr.
